tree-gnome-king.speaker: King Bolren
tree-gnome-king.text: Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.

tree-gnome-king.speaker: King Bolren
tree-gnome-king.text: I'm surprised you made it in, maybe I made the maze too easy.

tree-gnome-king.speaker: King Bolren
tree-gnome-king.text: I'm afraid I have more serious concerns at the moment. Very serious.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: I'm glad you asked.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: The truth is my people are in grave danger. We have always been protected by the Spirit Tree. No creature of dark can harm us while its three orbs are in place.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: We are not a violent race, but we fight when we must. Many gnomes have fallen battling the dark forces of Khazard to the North.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: Khazard troops seized the orb. Now we are completely defenceless.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: You would be a huge benefit on the battlefield. If you would go there and try to retrieve the orb, my people and I will be forever grateful.
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 45.

steps.prompt: Start the Tree Gnome Village quest?

steps.player: I would be glad to help.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: That is if he's still alive.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb
Elkoy guides you out of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.

steps.player: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: Ok then, travel safe.

options.text: I'll leave you to it then.

steps.player: I'll leave you to it then.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: Ok, take care.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-elkoy-after-s.speaker: Elkoy
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-elkoy-after-s.text: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please help us get our orb back.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-elkoy-after-s.speaker: Elkoy
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-elkoy-after-s.text: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you back to the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please help us get our orb back.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-remsai.speaker: Remsai
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-remsai.text: The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-kalron.speaker: Kalron
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-kalron.text: Oh my. I'll never find my way back before Khazard's men come and hunt me down.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-king-bolren-a.speaker: King Bolren
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-king-bolren-a.text: Hello traveller, we must retrieve the orb. It's being held by Khazard troops north of here.

tree-gnome-king-talking-to-king-bolren-a.speaker: King Bolren
tree-gnome-king-talking-to-king-bolren-a.text: The orb is being held at the battlefield north of the maze.

battlefield-commander-montai.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-commander-montai.text: Hello traveller, are you here to help or just to watch?

battlefield-commander-montai.player: I've been sent by King Bolren to retrieve the orb of protection.

battlefield-commander-montai.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-commander-montai.text: Excellent we need all the help we can get.

battlefield-commander-montai.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-commander-montai.text: I'm commander Montai. The orb is in the Khazard stronghold to the north, but until we weaken their defences we can't get close.

battlefield-commander-montai.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-commander-montai.text: Firstly we need to strengthen our own defences. We desperately need wood to make more battlements, once the battlements are gone it's all over. Six loads of normal logs should do it.

options.text: Sorry, I no longer want to be involved.

steps.player: Sorry I no longer want to be involved.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: That's a shame, we could have done with your help.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: Please be as quick as you can, I don't know how much longer we can hold out.

battlefield-attempting-to-fire-the-balli.text: The ballista is damaged. It cannot be used until the gnomes have finished their repairs.

battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-1.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-1.text: I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here?

battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-2.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-2.text: The battle is far from over. If you have a pure heart you will help us win.

battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-3.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-talking-to-tracker-gnome-3.text: I can't stand this war. The misery, the pain, it's driving me crazy! When will it end?

battlefield-talking-to-the-khazard-warlo.speaker: Khazard warlord
battlefield-talking-to-the-khazard-warlo.text: Don't speak to me you insignificant wretch! Die in the name of Khazard!

battlefield-talking-to-elkoy-after-agree.speaker: Elkoy
battlefield-talking-to-elkoy-after-agree.text: You must retrieve the orb, or the gnome village is doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?

battlefield-commander-montai-again.text: If the player doesn't have 6 logs in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier. We need six loads of normal logs.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: Thank you.

battlefield-commander-montai-again.text: If the player has 6 logs in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier.

steps.player: I have some here. (You give six loads of logs to the commander.)

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: That's excellent, now we can make more defensive battlements.  Give me a moment to organise the troops and then come speak to me. I'll inform you of our next phase of attack.

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.text: We're hanging in there soldier. For the next phase of our attack we need to breach their stronghold.

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.text: The ballista can break through the stronghold wall, and then we can advance and seize back the orb.

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.text: From this distance we can't get an accurate enough shot.  We need the correct coordinates of the stronghold for a direct hit.  I've sent out three tracker gnomes to gather them.

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.text: I'm afraid not, and we're running out of time. I need you to go into the heart of the battlefield, find the trackers, and bring back the coordinates.

battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-talking-to-commander-montai-.text: Do you think you can do it?

options.text: No, I've had enough of your battle.

steps.player: No, I've had enough of your battle.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: I understand, this isn't your fight.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: Thank you, you're braver than most.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: I don't know how long I will be able to hold out. Once you have the coordinates come back and fire the ballista right into those monsters.

steps.speaker: Commander Montai
steps.text: If you can retrieve the orb and bring safety back to my people, none of the blood spilled on this field will be in vain.

battlefield-commander-montai-while-getti.speaker: Commander Montai
battlefield-commander-montai-while-getti.text: Hello warrior. We need the coordinates for a direct hit from the ballista. Once you have a direct hit you will be able to enter the stronghold and retrieve the orb.

battlefield-attempting-to-enter-the-stro.text: The door is locked from the inside.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.player: Do you know the coordinates of the Khazard stronghold?

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: I managed to get one, although it wasn't easy.
The gnome tells you the height coordinate.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: The other two tracker gnomes should have the other coordinates if they're still alive.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: They caught me spying on the stronghold. They beat and tortured me.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: But I didn't crack. I told them nothing. They can't break me!

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: Don't be. I have the position of the stronghold!
The gnome tells you the y coordinate.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: Now leave before they find you and all is lost.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: Go!

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: OK? Who's OK? Not me! Hee hee!

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: You can't see me, no one can. Monsters, demons, they're all around me!

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: They're dancing, all of them, hee hee.
He's clearly lost the plot.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.player: Do you have the coordinate for the Khazard stronghold?

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: Who holds the stronghold?
If the coordinate is one:

steps.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
steps.text: Less than my hands.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: If the coordinate is two:

steps.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
steps.text: More than my head, less than my fingers.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: If the coordinate is three:

steps.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
steps.text: More than we, less than our feet.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: If the coordinate is four:

steps.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
steps.text: My legs and your legs, ha ha ha!

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: Dance with me, and Khazard's men are beat.
The toll of war has affected his mind.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.player: I'll pray for you little man.

battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
battlefield-tracker-gnomes-tracker-gnome.text: All day we pray in the hay, hee hee.

using-the-ballista.player: That tracker gnome was a bit vague about the x coordinate! What could it be?

using-the-ballista.prompt: Enter the x-coordinate of the stronghold

using-the-ballista.text: You enter the height and y coordinates you got from the tracker gnomes.
If the player chooses the wrong coordinate:

steps.text: The huge spear completely misses the Khazard stronghold!

steps.player: Evidently that wasn't the right x coordinate.

using-the-ballista.text: If the player chooses the correct coordinate:

steps.text: The huge spear flies through the air and screams down directly into the Khazard stronghold. A deafening crash echoes over the battlefield as the front entrance is reduced to rubble.

using-the-ballista-using-the-ballista-ag.text: The Khazard stronghold has already been breached.

using-the-ballista-commander-montai-afte.speaker: Commander Montai
using-the-ballista-commander-montai-afte.text: I saw, that was a beautiful sight. The Khazard troops didn't know what hit them.

using-the-ballista-commander-montai-afte.speaker: Commander Montai
using-the-ballista-commander-montai-afte.text: Now is the time to retrieve the orb. It's all in your hands. I'll be praying for you.

using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.text: Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.

using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.text: Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.

using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
using-the-ballista-talking-to-tracker-gn.text: Don't talk to me, you can't see me. No one can, just the demons.

into-the-stronghold.text: The wall has been reduced to rubble. It should be possible to climb over the remains...

into-the-stronghold.speaker: Khazard commander
into-the-stronghold.text: Don't even think of taking the orb!

into-the-stronghold-upon-opening-the-che.speaker: Khazard commander
into-the-stronghold-upon-opening-the-che.text: Oi! You! Get out of there.
You search the chest. Inside you find gnomes' stolen orb of protection.

into-the-stronghold-opening-the-strongho.text: The door seems to be locked from the inside. I'll need to find another way to get in.

into-the-stronghold-commander-montai-aft.player: I have the orb of protection.

into-the-stronghold-commander-montai-aft.speaker: Commander Montai
into-the-stronghold-commander-montai-aft.text: Incredible, for a human you really are something.

into-the-stronghold-commander-montai-aft.speaker: Commander Montai
into-the-stronghold-commander-montai-aft.text: I'll stay here with my troops and try and hold Khazard's men back. You return the orb to the gnome village. Go as quick as you can, the village is still unprotected.

into-the-stronghold-tracker-gnome-1-afte.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
into-the-stronghold-tracker-gnome-1-afte.text: Now we have the orb I'm much better. They won't stand a chance without it.

into-the-stronghold-tracker-gnome-2-afte.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
into-the-stronghold-tracker-gnome-2-afte.text: Now we have the orb I'm much better. Soon my comrades will come and free me.

into-the-stronghold-talking-to-elkoy-wit.speaker: Elkoy
into-the-stronghold-talking-to-elkoy-wit.text: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please help us get our orb back.

into-the-stronghold-talking-to-elkoy-wit.speaker: Elkoy
into-the-stronghold-talking-to-elkoy-wit.text: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please help us get our orb back.

into-the-stronghold-talking-to-remsai-wi.speaker: Remsai
into-the-stronghold-talking-to-remsai-wi.text: Hello, did you find the orb?

into-the-stronghold-talking-to-remsai-wi.speaker: Remsai
into-the-stronghold-talking-to-remsai-wi.text: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.

into-the-stronghold-talking-to-bolren-wi.speaker: King Bolren
into-the-stronghold-talking-to-bolren-wi.text: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.

into-the-stronghold-elkoy-after-getting-.speaker: Elkoy
into-the-stronghold-elkoy-after-getting-.text: You're our saviour. Please return it to the village and we are all saved. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Here we are. Take the orb to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.

into-the-stronghold-elkoy-after-getting-.player: Hello Elkoy. I have the orb.

into-the-stronghold-elkoy-after-getting-.speaker: Elkoy
into-the-stronghold-elkoy-after-getting-.text: Take it to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.

options.text: Can you show me out of the village?

steps.player: Can you show me out of the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please return with our orb soon.

into-the-stronghold-remsai-after-getting.speaker: Remsai
into-the-stronghold-remsai-after-getting.text: Hello, did you find the orb?

into-the-stronghold-local-gnomes-after-g.speaker: Local Gnome
into-the-stronghold-local-gnomes-after-g.text: Little man stronger than big man. Hee hee, lardi dee, lardi da.

into-the-stronghold-bolkoy-after-getting.speaker: Bolkoy
into-the-stronghold-bolkoy-after-getting.text: Well I am impressed. Would you like to buy something?

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: Oh my... The misery, the horror!

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: Thank you traveller, but it's too late. We're all doomed.

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: They came in the night. I don't know how many, but enough.

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: Khazard troops. They slaughtered anyone who got in their way. Women, children, my wife.

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: They took the other orbs, now we are defenceless.

bringing-bolren-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
bringing-bolren-the-orb.text: They headed north of the stronghold. A warlord carries the orbs.

options.text: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.

steps.player: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
Elkoy guides you out of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Good luck friend.

options.text: I'm sorry but I can't help.

steps.player: I'm sorry but I can't help

steps.speaker: King Bolren
steps.text: I understand, this isn't your battle.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.speaker: Elkoy
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.text: Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?

options.text: Can you show me out of the village?

steps.player: Can you show me out of the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you out of the maze.
The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Please help us find the orbs.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.speaker: Elkoy
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.text: Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.speaker: Elkoy
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-elkoy.text: Would you like me to show you the way to the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Here we are. Despite what has happened here, I hope you feel welcome.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Ok then, take care.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-remsa.speaker: Remsai
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-remsa.text: Khazard's men came. Without the orb we were defenceless. They killed many and then took our last hope, the other orbs.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-remsa.speaker: Remsai
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-remsa.text: Now surely we're all doomed. Without them the spirit tree is useless.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-kalro.speaker: Kalron
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-kalro.text: Oh my, oh my, the village has been pillaged and I'm still lost. Oh dear.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-the-l.speaker: Local Gnome
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-the-l.text: Must save the orbs and kill the Khazard warlord. That will be fun, hee hee.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-comma.speaker: Commander Montai
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-comma.text: I'm ok, this battle is going to take longer to win than I expected. The Khazard troops won't give up even without the orb.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-bolko.speaker: Bolkoy
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-bolko.text: Oh, hello there. Have you heard? They took the other orbs, it's terrible. I suppose the show must go on.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-bolko.speaker: Bolkoy
bringing-bolren-the-orb-talking-to-bolko.text: Would you like to buy something?

bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-1.speaker: Tracker gnome 1
bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-1.text: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been fighting forever.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-2.speaker: Tracker gnome 2
bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-2.text: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been locked up my whole life.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-3.speaker: Tracker gnome 3
bringing-bolren-the-orb-tracker-gnome-3.text: I feel dizzy, where am I? Oh dear, oh dear I need some rest.

bringing-bolren-the-orb-khazard-warlord.speaker: Khazard warlord
bringing-bolren-the-orb-khazard-warlord.text: You think you're so clever. You know nothing!

bringing-bolren-the-orb-khazard-warlord.speaker: Khazard warlord
bringing-bolren-the-orb-khazard-warlord.text: I'll crush you and those pesky little green men!

the-khazard-warlord.speaker: Khazard warlord
the-khazard-warlord.text: Go back to your pesky little green friends.

the-khazard-warlord.speaker: Khazard warlord
the-khazard-warlord.text: You're out of your depth traveller. These orbs are part of a much larger picture.

the-khazard-warlord.player: They're stolen goods, now give them here!

the-khazard-warlord.speaker: Khazard warlord
the-khazard-warlord.text: Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.

the-khazard-warlord-when-defeated.text: As the warlord falls to the ground, a ghostly vapour floats upwards from his battle-worn armour. Out of sight you hear a shrill scream in the still air. You spot the orbs of protection among his remains.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-the-khaza.speaker: Khazard warlord
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-the-khaza.text: Fool, warriors blessed by Khazard don't die. You can't kill that which is already dead. However I can kill you!

the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.speaker: Elkoy
the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.text: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well.

the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.speaker: Elkoy
the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.text: Would you like me to show you the way to the village?

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Ok then, take care.

the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.speaker: Elkoy
the-khazard-warlord-elkoy-after-defeatin.text: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well. Would you like me to show you through the maze?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.

steps.speaker: Elkoy
steps.text: Here we are. Have a safe journey.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-remsai-af.speaker: Remsai
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-remsai-af.text: You're back, well done brave adventurer. Now the orbs are safe we can perform the ritual for the spirit tree. We can live in peace once again.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-the-local.speaker: Local Gnome
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-the-local.text: Soon we're gonna have the sacred ceremony and boy am I going to party. Lock up your daughters. Hee hee.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-kalron-af.speaker: Kalron
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-kalron-af.text: Hello. I hope they come out and find me soon. It's getting cold.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-bolkoy-af.speaker: Bolkoy
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-bolkoy-af.text: Hello there. You're that hero who saved the orbs. Soon we will perform the ritual and the village will be safe again.

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-bolkoy-af.speaker: Bolkoy
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-bolkoy-af.text: Anyway, would you like anything from my shop?

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-king-bolr.speaker: King Bolren
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-king-bolr.text: You made it back! Do you have the orbs?

the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-king-bolr.speaker: King Bolren
the-khazard-warlord-talking-to-king-bolr.text: Please, we must have the orbs if we are to survive.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: You made it back! Do you have the orbs?

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: Hooray, you're amazing. I didn't think it was possible but you've saved us.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: Once the orbs are replaced we will be safe once more. We must begin the ceremony immediately.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: The spirit tree has looked over us for centuries. Now we must pay our respects.
The gnomes begin to chant. Meanwhile, King Bolren holds the orbs of protection out in front of him.
The orbs of protection come to rest gently in the branches of the ancient spirit tree.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: Now at last my people are safe once more. We can live in peace again.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: Please, for your efforts take this amulet. It's made from the same sacred stone as the orbs of protection. It will help keep you safe on your journeys.

return-of-the-orb.speaker: King Bolren
return-of-the-orb.text: The tree has many other powers, some of which I cannot reveal. As a friend of the gnome people, I can now allow you to use the tree's magic to teleport to other trees grown from related seeds.
